option_relations.rationale: Polymorphous light eruption, pustular variant, is a photodermatosis characterized by polymorphic lesions, which can include pustules, but it is distinct from subcorneal pustular dermatosis.
Acne aestivalis (Mallorca acne) is a form of acne triggered by sun exposure, typically presenting with papules and pustules, but it is not equivalent to subcorneal pustular dermatosis.
Actinic folliculitis is an inflammatory condition of hair follicles related to sun exposure, which can present with pustules, but it is not the same as subcorneal pustular dermatosis.
Eosinophilic folliculitis is a type of folliculitis characterized by eosinophilic infiltration, which is distinct from subcorneal pustular dermatosis.
